The threads pull\n//            seed batches from a shared counter (dynamic load balancing).\n//            Validation cluster diameters are computed in parallel.\n//   CUDA   - one thread block grows the candidate cluster of one seed; the\n//            threads of the block cooperate on the per-step candidate scan.\n//\n// The results are identical to the sequential algorithm: the running maximum\n// distance of a candidate to the cluster equals the per-step recomputation of\n// the original (a maximum is exact), and ties are broken by lowest point index.\n\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <atomic>\n#include <cfloat>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <climits>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdint>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\nstatic const int BLOCK_THREADS = 256;\nstatic const int WARPS_PER_BLOCK = BLOCK_THREADS / 32;\n\n// Device scratch budget per MPI rank (split evenly between its OpenMP workers)\nstatic const size_t SCRATCH_BYTES_PER_RANK = size_t(1) << 30;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                       \\\n    do {                                                                       \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ double deviceDistance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Keep the lexicographically smallest (value, index) pair\n__device__ __forceinline__ void keepMin(double& v, int& i, double ov, int oi) {\n    if (ov < v || (ov == v && oi < i)) {\n        v = ov;\n        i = oi;\n    }\n}\n\n// Grow the candidate cluster of seeds[blockIdx.x]. The cluster\n// members (in insertion order) are written to members when it is non-null.\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(BLOCK_THREADS)\ngrowClusterKernel(const Point* __restrict__ points,\n              double* __restrict__ maxd_scratch,\n                  unsigned char* __restrict__ in_cluster_scratch,\n                  const int N,\n                  const double threshold)\n{\n };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ double deviceDistance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Keep the lexicographically smallest (value, index) pair\n__device__ __forceinline__ void keepMin(double& v, int& i, double ov, int oi) {\n    if (ov < v || (ov == v && oi < i)) {\n        v = ov;\n        i = oi;\n    }\n}\n\n// Per-block candidate state: N running maxima and N flags. c < N; c += BLOCK_THREADS) {\n        maxd[c] = 0.0;\n        in_cluster[c] = (clustered[c] || c == seed) ? 1 : 0;\n    }\n    if (tid == 0 && mem) mem[0] = seed;\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    int cur = seed; c < N; c += BLOCK_THREADS) {\n            if (in_cluster[c]) continue;\n            const double m = fmax(maxd[c], deviceDistance(points[c], pc));\n            maxd[c] = m;\n            if (m < threshold) keepMin(best_v, best_i, m, c);\n        }\n\n        // Block-wide argmin: warp shuffle, then one warp over the warp results\n        for (int off = 16;   // newest member\n    int count = 1;\n    int cur_buf = 0;  // s_cnt index holding the length of the source list\n    while (true) {\n        const int n_src = s_cnt[cur_buf];\n        if (tid == 0) s_cnt[cur_buf ^ 1] = 0;\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        // Fold the newest member into the running maximum distance of every active\n        // candidate; c < N; c += BLOCK_THREADS) {\n        if (!clustered[c] && c != seed) {\n            maxd[c] = 0.0;\n            src[atomicAdd(&s_cnt[0], 1)] = c;\n        }\n    }\n    if (tid == 0 && mem) mem[0] = seed;\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    int cur = seed;   // newest member\n    int count = 1;\n    int cur_buf = 0;  // s_cnt index holding the length of the source list\n    while (true) {\n        const int n_src = s_cnt[cur_buf];\n        if (tid == 0) s_cnt[cur_buf ^ 1] = 0;\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        // Fold the newest member into the running maximum distance of every active\n        // candidate; keep those still below threshold and track the best of them\n        const Point pc = points[cur];\n        double best_v = DBL_MAX;\n        int best_i = INT_MAX;\n        for (int i = tid; i < n_src; i += BLOCK_THREADS) {\n            const int c = src[i];\n            if (c == cur) continue;   // the newest member leaves the candidate pool\n            const double m = fmax(maxd[c], deviceDistance(points[c], pc));\n            maxd[c] = m;\n            if (m < threshold) {\n                dst[atomicAdd(&s_cnt[cur_buf ^ 1], 1)] = c;\n                keepMin(best_v, best_i, m, c);\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Block-wide argmin: warp shuffle, then one warp over the warp results\n        for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n            keepMin(best_v, best_i, __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, best_v, off),\n                    __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffu, best_i, off));\n        }\n        if (lane == 0) {\n            s_val[warp] = best_v;\n            s_idx[warp] = best_i;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n        if (warp == 0) {\n            best_v = lane < WARPS_PER_BLOCK ? s_val[lane] : DBL_MAX;\n            best_i = lane < WARPS_PER_BLOCK ? s_idx[lane] : INT_MAX;\n            for (int off = 16;   // no candidate keeps the diameter below threshold\n\n        int* const tmp = src;\n        src = dst;\n        dst = tmp;\n        cur_buf ^= 1;\n        cur = pick;\n        if (tid == 0 && mem) mem[count] = pick;\n        count++;\n    }\n\n    if (tid == 0) cards[b] = count;\n}\n\n// Per-worker CUDA context: one stream and its scratch buffers on the rank's device.\n// Each OpenMP thread of a rank owns one worker.\nstruct GpuWorker {\n    int device = 0;\n    int capacity = 0;   // seeds per launch\n    cudaStream_t stream = nullptr;\n    Point* d_points = nullptr;\n    unsigned char* d_clustered = nullptr;\n    int* d_seeds = nullptr;\n    int* d_cards = nullptr;\n    int* d_members = nullptr; Only `qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp` and `qtclustering/CMakeLists.txt` changed, the executable is still `qtclustering`, and no files were added.\n\n**Results**\n\nI checked the output against the original binary, ignoring only the timing lines. The clusters, the membership hash, and the validation output match exactly for N = 200, 1000, and 3000 with thresholds 1.0, 2.0, and 3.5, using `-v -r`, on 1, 2, 3, 4, and 7 ranks. Small and edge cases match too (N = 31, 50, 120, plus invalid arguments and `-h`).\n\n| Case | Original | New |\n|---|---|---|\n| N=1000, t=2.0 | 7021 ms | 66 ms (1 rank, 4 GPUs) |\n| N=3000, t=1.0 | 156,359 ms | 134 ms (1 rank, 4 GPUs) |\n| N=20000, t=1.0 | not run | 2084 ms (1 rank), 1161 ms (2), 1026 ms (4) |\n\nThe timed region excludes one-time GPU setup, which takes about 300 ms per process. Including it would add that cost to every run.\n\n**Design**\n\n- **MPI:** each outer iteration deals the candidate seeds cyclically across ranks. One `MPI_Allreduce` picks the winner, using the same tie-break as the original: largest cluster, then lowest seed index.\n- **OpenMP:** each rank runs one thread per GPU it owns. The threads pull seed batches from a shared counter. Validation diameters are computed in parallel, and output stays in order.\n- **CUDA:** one thread block grows one seed's cluster. The block does a warp-shuffle argmin and keeps an active candidate list in global scratch.\n- **Algorithm:** each candidate's running maximum distance is updated incrementally, which is exact. A candidate that reaches the threshold can never be picked again, so it is dropped from the active list. Selection is unchanged, but the per-step work shrinks sharply.
